Basics

Fridge fruit sauce

Gyümölcsszósz

6 months+ Replaced 20 min 6 portions

From 6 months, on porridge or as a spoon. Leave it unsweetened at every age.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 2 eating apples (peeled and cored)
  • 100 g fresh or frozen berries (no grapes and no sulphite-preserved dried fruit)
  • 3 tbsp water (just enough to stop sticking)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Chop the apples and add the berries.
  2. Cook with the water for about 10 minutes, until soft.
  3. Mash or blend to a sauce.
  4. Cool it quickly.
  5. Keep it for up to three days in the fridge, or freeze small portions.
  6. Serve with no honey and no sugar.

Replaced

The usual jam was boiled for hours and could be finished with honey after one year.

Short-cook apple and berries into a sauce with no honey. Once cool, keep it for three days in the fridge or freeze it.
